theory: The triangular-prism net is geometrically incompatible: each rectangle has width 2, but each drawn triangle has base 2 and sloping edges of length sqrt(3.25), so those edges cannot meet the adjacent rectangles. Make the triangle and rectangle edge lengths agree. Qualify the statement that a prism's connecting faces are rectangles as applying to right prisms.
